nodes.label: deploy.yml — Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on every push to main (plus manual workflow_dispatch), so deploying is just git push origin main. Least-privilege permissions (contents read, pages write, id-token write); concurrency group 'pages' cancels superseded runs.

nodes.label: build-deploy job
nodes.rationale: ubuntu-latest + Node 22 with npm cache: npm ci → npm run build → configure-pages → upload dist/ → deploy-pages. deploy-pages is continue-on-error and retried once after a 45s wait because the Pages service can be transiently unavailable. Only the build (tsc + vite) runs in CI — npm test is not executed.

nodes.label: VITE_USDA_KEY (USDA API key secret)
nodes.rationale: Optional repo secret for the full 1,000 req/hr USDA allowance; when unset the code falls back to DEMO_KEY (~30 req/hr/IP). Vite inlines VITE_* vars into the public bundle at build time, so .env/secrets only keep it out of git — acceptable solely because it is a free per-IP-rate-limited key.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages (static hosting)
nodes.rationale: Hosts the no-backend PWA under the /GymTracker/ base path (live at https://monniale.github.io/GymTracker/); the repo's Pages source must be set to GitHub Actions.
